photos.llama_desc: A woman with long dark hair in a white jacket is sitting at a table with a birthday cake with two lit candles. The table is set with a white and red tablecloth and a white and red placemat. The woman is smiling and looking at the camera.

A young girl with long blonde hair and a wide, toothy smile. She is looking directly at the camera with her eyes, her face is slightly tilted to the right, and her mouth is open to show her teeth. She is wearing a white and black shirt with a black collar.

A young girl in a white t-shirt with a colorful design, making a peace sign with her hands, lying on a white door. She has long brown hair and is wearing a red and white striped skirt. The door is white with a brown frame and has a window on the left.

A woman in a red dress with a pattern of black dogs and white dots is sitting on a couch with a small dog, a Yorkshire terrier, who is playing with a gift-wrapped present. The woman is wearing black socks and has her feet on a brown and grey rug. The dog is wearing a red collar and is standing on the rug, which is on a brown and grey carpet.

A young girl holding a red piece of paper with a gold flower design. She is wearing a blue and grey dress with a gold belt, pink tights, and has blonde hair. She is standing in a room with a green rug and a wall with vertical stripes.

A young girl in a red shirt with a flower design on the front, standing in front of a pool with a blue tarp covering it, with a man in a white shirt and a man in a blue chair in the background. The girl is looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. The man in the white shirt is sitting in a chair with his back to the camera, and the man in the blue chair is sitting in a chair with his back to the camera.

A family of five sitting around a table in a dining room. A woman in a red sweater and a man in a suit and tie are sitting at the head of the table, with a Christmas tree in the background. The table is set with plates, cups, and a Christmas-themed tablecloth.
